subject.title: fix(memory-core): clear daily-ingestion sqlite namespace on dreaming repair

question: Should `memory status --fix` clear the migrated `dreaming-daily-ingestion` SQLite namespace whenever dreaming repair archives the session corpus or session-ingestion state?
rationale: The code change is narrow and well-proven, but it deliberately deletes persisted plugin-state rows under an explicit repair command, so maintainer intent should confirm the repair semantic before merge.

options.title: Accept Symmetric Repair
options.body: Merge the PR so repair clears all three audited ingestion namespaces and lets later sweeps rebuild daily bookkeeping.

options.title: Preserve Daily Bookkeeping
options.body: Ask for a different repair shape if daily-ingestion rows should survive session-corpus archival despite audit treating them as ingestion state.
